verdict.rationale: Neon documents webhooks only for its Managed Better Auth component. They deliver authentication events to custom server logic, including replacing the built-in email provider with SMS, WhatsApp or custom delivery. Nothing in the pack shows general platform event subscriptions such as project, branch, compute or database-change events. Missing for 10: platform-wide event webhooks beyond auth, documented event catalog, delivery/retry/signing details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
